analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Riga (19th, three points from three 1-1 draws) host Atalanta (16th, four points) on matchday 5. Atalanta under Maurizio Sarri have a long injury list (Gaetano, Bellanova, Kristensen, Hien, Raspadori and Kossounou missed the win at Monza) and only ended a six-game winless run on 8 November. Much depends on who is back by December.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean a little lower: all three of Riga's games ended 1-1, and Atalanta's injury-hit attack has scored twice in its last two games.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners, 5.8 for Atalanta. Sarri's side should have most of the ball, which the split reflects.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. No referee is known and nothing in either side's games moves this.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.3 shots, 17.3 for Atalanta. I lean lower: Atalanta have not produced high shot counts while short of attackers, and Riga have kept games tight.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. For the same reasons, I lean slightly lower; this could change if Atalanta's injured forwards return.
